instructions: Materialize fixtures in the existing isolated runner. Keep expected checks evaluator-owned and hidden from the tested agent. These records are neither executed fixtures nor benchmark results.

cases.task: Add a date input using the existing form conventions.
fixture: An accessible house Input component supports type=date.
Supported browser and locale requirements are explicit; no custom calendar is required.
checks: Requested date value and existing validation round-trip correctly.
Reuses the house component; introduces no calendar package or parallel form abstraction.
Preserves label association, keyboard interaction and error presentation.
